page.layout: One page of text in a single column of dictionary entries, each opening with a Hebrew headword set in larger type at the left. No margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: כַּכָּר f. Massa, Frustum, Tracta: Planities, cum de Terra dicitur, Genes.13.12. Talentum, cum de Metallis, Exod.38.25. Ubi notant Hebraei, Talentum continuisse sexaginta minas sacras, id est, vulgares centum viginti. Minam viginti quinque siclos. Ergo Talentum ter mille siclos. Aben Esra. R. Salomon. Constr. כִּכַּר עָפְרַת Massa plumbi, Zach.5.7. עַד־כִּכַּר לֶחֶם Usque ad fructum panis, Prov.6.26. כִּכַּר לֶחֶם אַחַת Tractam panis unam, Exod.29.23. vulgo Tortam vertunt: Duale, קַח כִּכָּרַיִם Accipite duo talenta, 2.Reg.5.23. Constr. כִּכְּרֵי כָסֶף Talenta duo argenti, ibid. Plur. כִּכָּרִים Talenta, 1.Par.22.14. Constr. כִּכְּרֵי כֶסֶף Talenta argenti, 2.Reg.5.5. Chald. כִּכָּרִין Talenta, Esr.7.22. Foemin. כִּכָּרוֹת לֶחֶם Tractas panis, Jud.8.5.

כָּלָא Clausit, Inclusit, Occlusit, Cohibuit, Continuit, Coercuit: Confundit interdum formam cum כָּלָה : ut Praeter. כָּלִאתִי Cohibui, Psal.119.101. כָּלוּ Occluserunt, 1.Sam.6.10. pro כָּלְאוּ : Et intransitive, כָּלְאוּ Clauserunt vel cohibuerunt se, Hag.1.10. כָּלֵאתַנִי Continuisti me, 1.Sam.25.33. Niph.Futur. יִכָּלֵא Cohibebitur, Gen.8.v.2. וַיִּכָּלְאוּ Et coercentur, Ezech.31.15. Pih.Imp. כַּלֵּה Cohibe, Psal.74.11. cum ה loco א. Infin. לִכְלֹא Ad cohibendum, Dan.9.24.
כְּלָא m. Coercitio, Cohibitio, Carcer, coercitionis locus, 2.Reg.17.4. Aff. כַּלְאוֹ Carceris sui, 2.Reg.25.29. Plural. כְּלָאִים Carceres, Jesa.42.22.
כְּלִיא m. Idem, Jer.37.4. quod legitur כְּלוֹא.

מִכְלָה f. Caula: מִכְלָה E' caula, Abac.3.16. cum ה loco א, vel potius contractum pro מִכְלָאָה, ut liquet ex plurali. Constr. מִכְלְאוֹת צֹאן Ex cauls ovium, Psal.78.70. Aff. מִכְלְאוֹתֶיךָ E' caulis tuis, Psal.50.9.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh in the entries are small and partly blurred; the Hebrew is copied as far as it is legible, and the points should be checked against the scan. "cauls" in the first Mikhlah entry ("Ex cauls ovium") may be a printing error for "caulis" [?]. The large Hebrew headwords at the left of each entry are set in larger type and are copied as the headword of each paragraph. The Hebrew running head and the catchword כלאים are read from the page; the catchword is not repeated in the text.
